description: Rochester, NY - Today, the Rochester Teacher’s Association (RTA) endorsed Joe Morelle’s candidacy for Congress in the 25th District. An affiliate of the American Federation of teachers, RTA has approximately 4,000 members in the Rochester region.

title: RTA Endorses Morelle - Joe Morelle for Congress
